verdict.rationale: Visa documents a dedicated Intelligent Commerce sandbox. Developers self-register through a sandbox sign-up form and can then send test transactions via a Test Enterprise Business Center. The APIs use a separate test host (apitest.visaacceptance.com) from production (api.visaacceptance.com), and the sandbox is explicitly free while production is priced separately. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that the sandbox works end to end, documented test card and sandbox data behavior, and instant keyless sandbox access (signup is form-based, with account instructions sent by email).
